The meaning of the word translated as **enclosed** is uncertain. It could mean: (1) “enclosed by walls.” Alternate translation: [walled] (2) “small.” Alternate translation: [small] (3) “smoking,” that is, built to let smoke escape. Alternate translation: [unroofed]

The word **cornered** is a translation of the standard written Hebrew text as we have it today. There is, however, a correction in the margin of the text indicating that Hebrew scribes considered that this word was accidentally inserted and therefore does not belong in the text. You may want to follow this correction in your translation along with the UST, or you may want to follow the major translation in your area.
